title: Who is reading? (very first screen)
note: The first screen ever shown: two big cards, a child or a grown-up, with the choice spoken in English.

title: After picking a child: the first sitting starts by itself
note: Straight into the first sound game with Tilo in the header, no sign-up and no language step.

title: Who is reading? once a profile exists
note: The same picker on a later visit, now with an 'Or carry on' button for the profile that already exists.

title: Privacy screen (top)
note: The plain-text privacy page: works offline, no account, no ads, no analytics, all data stays on the phone.

title: After picking a grown-up: the first sitting
note: The same first sitting for a grown-up: plain page, no mascot, no speech bubble.

title: Grown-up gate (grownup.js)
note: A multiplication sum in digits that a young child cannot do; it keeps the privacy page and grown-up area away from children.

title: Grown-up gate after a wrong answer
note: A wrong answer shows 'Not quite. Try this one.' and a new sum; three misses lock it for 30 seconds.

title: Settings screen
note: COULD NOT REACH: the app has no settings screen; the only grown-up areas are the 'Who is reading?' picker and the gated privacy page

title: Track A home, first visit
note: Child home: Tilo in the hero, an empty village, and the path with the first sitting open and the rest locked.

title: Locked node on the path
note: A node with a padlock: it opens only after the sitting before it is passed.

title: Track A home after some lessons
note: Child home with village pieces, a row of stickers, days practised in the header and done ticks on the path.

title: Level map: done, open and locked nodes
note: The path in the middle of Level 1: ticked nodes behind, one open node, locked nodes ahead.

title: Level card, locked
note: Level 2 card, greyed and locked until the Level 1 check is passed.

title: Track B home, first visit
note: Grown-up home: a plain 'Lessons' list and a count of words you can read, with no mascot and no village.

title: Track B home after some lessons
note: Grown-up home with done ticks, 'checked by tapping' and 'still learning' badges and the words to remember.

title: First sound game
note: 'What sound does it start with?': a real picture and three sound cards, no letters yet.

title: Blend the sounds, with pictures
note: 'Which word do the sounds make?': a picture on each answer card.

title: Listen intro with big Tilo
note: The Listen & Talk intro: big Tilo with his speech bubble and one large play button.

title: Listen story scenes
note: The story screen: the scene pictures appear after each chunk of the story.

title: Listen question
note: 'Say your answer out loud': the scene above a big microphone cue, no tapping needed.

title: Mini check intro
note: 'Show what you know': the short check at the end of the oral lessons.

title: Mini check item
note: One item of the check: hear the sounds, pick the word, one try.

title: Meet the letter
note: 'This letter makes that sound': the letter card, tap to hear it.

title: Trace the letter
note: Finger-trace the letter on a canvas with a guide.

title: Wrong answer with encouraging Tilo
note: A wrong pick on a first-sound card: Tilo takes the thinking pose (hand on chin) and the cards stay for another try.

title: Blend it
note: 'Blend it': the printed word split into sounds, tapped one by one.

title: Tap gate: pick the word you heard
note: The 2x2 tap gate: four printed words that differ in one or two sounds.

title: Wrong answer on a tap gate
note: A wrong pick on a printed-word gate: the app repeats the right sound and the gate stays for a second try. (Tilo's pose was not caught on this frame)

title: Correct answer cheer
note: A right pick: Tilo celebrates.

title: Tricky word
note: A 'heart word': tap the part of the word that does not follow the usual sounds.

title: Spell it
note: Spell a whole word by dropping letters into the slots.

title: End of a sitting with the mini check score
note: 'Well done!': dots for each first-try answer, a sticker and Tilo celebrating.

title: Read it
note: A short page to read aloud; tap a word to hear it.

title: Review sitting: name and sound
note: A review sitting: a letter has a name and a sound.

title: Review: b d p q
note: The four look-alike letters side by side.

title: Mastery check: real words
